arxiv-2204-06689.title: Experimental quantum state discrimination using the optimal fixed rate of inconclusive outcomes strategy
arxiv-2204-06689.creator: Santiago Gómez, Esteban S. Gómez, Omar Jiménez, Aldo Delgado, Stephen P. Walborn, Gustavo Lima
arxiv-2204-06689.description: Abstract The problem of non-orthogonal state discrimination underlies crucial quantum information tasks, such as cryptography and computing protocols. Therefore, it is decisive to find optimal scenarios for discrimination among quantum states. We experimentally investigate the strategy for the optimal discrimination of two non-orthogonal states considering a fixed rate of inconclusive outcomes (FRIO).

arxiv-2210-04774.title: Online Resource Allocation with Samples
arxiv-2210-04774.creator: Negin Golrezaei, Patrick Jaillet, Zijie Zhou
arxiv-2210-04774.description: Abstract We study an online resource allocation problem under uncertainty about demand and about the reward of each type of demand (agents) for the resource. Even though dealing with demand uncertainty in resource allocation problems has been the topic of many papers in the literature, the challenge of not knowing rewards has been barely explored.

arxiv-2302-07388.title: Adding Instructions during Pretraining: Effective Way of Controlling Toxicity in Language Models
arxiv-2302-07388.creator: Shrimai Prabhumoye, Mostofa Patwary, Mohammad Shoeybi, Bryan Catanzaro
arxiv-2302-07388.description: Abstract Pretrained large language models have become indispensable for solving various natural language processing (NLP) tasks. However, safely deploying them in real world applications is challenging because they generate toxic content. To address this challenge, we propose two novel pretraining data augmentation strategies that significantly reduce model toxicity without compromising its utility .

arxiv-2306-09346.title: Rosetta Neurons: Mining the Common Units in a Model Zoo
arxiv-2306-09346.creator: Amil DravidNorthwestern, Yossi GandelsmanUC BerkeleyAlexei A. EfrosUC BerkeleyAssaf ShocherUC Berkeley, Google
arxiv-2306-09346.description: Abstract † † footnotetext: * Equal contribution. Do different neural networks, trained for various vision tasks, share some common representations? In this paper, we demonstrate the existence of common features we call “Rosetta Neurons” across a range of models with different architectures, different tasks (generative and discriminative), and different types of supervision (class-supervised, text-supervised, self-supervised).

arxiv-2312-14783.title: Unboundedness of the images of set-valued mappings having closed graphs: Application to vector optimization
arxiv-2312-14783.creator: V.T. Hieu, E.A.S. Köbis, M.A. Köbis, P.H. Schmölling
arxiv-2312-14783.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by V.T. Hieu, E.A.S. Köbis, M.A. Köbis, P.H. Schmölling. In this paper, we propose criteria for unboundedness of the images of set-valued mappings having closed graphs in Euclidean spaces. We focus on mappings whose domains are non-closed or whose values are connected. These criteria allow us to see structural properties of solutions in vector optimization, where solution sets can be considered as the images of solution mappings associated to specific scalarization methods.

arxiv-2411-01778.title: Black Brane/Bose Gase Duality and Third Law of Thermodynamics
arxiv-2411-01778.creator: Irina Aref’eva, Daniil Stepanenko, Igor Volovich
arxiv-2411-01778.description: Abstract In the thermodynamics of black holes in asymptotically flat space, the third law of thermodynamics is violated, and entropy cannot be consistently modeled through conventional statistical mechanics. Notably, the third law of thermodynamics is violated for the Schwarzschild black hole, and its entropy can only be described using an unconventional model, such as a Bose gas in negative dimensions.

arxiv-2501-07675.creator: François Berteloot and Xavier Buff
arxiv-2501-07675.description: Abstract . In the context of holomorphic families of ℙ k \mathbb{P}^{k} endomorphisms, we show that various notions of stability are equivalent. This allows us to both extend and simplify the architecture of the proof of certain results of [ BBD ] . Keywords: holomorphic dynamics, dynamical stability. 1.

arxiv-2512-07280.title: ContinuumConductor : Decentralized Process Mining on the Edge-Cloud Continuum
arxiv-2512-07280.creator: Hendrik Reiter, Janick Edinger, Martin Kabierski, Agnes Koschmider, Olaf Landsiedel, Arvid Lepsien, Xixi Lu, Andrea Marrella, Estefania Serral, Stefan Schulte, Florian Tschorsch, Matthias Weidlich, Wilhelm Hasselbring
arxiv-2512-07280.description: Abstract Process mining traditionally assumes centralized event data collection and analysis. However, modern Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) systems increasingly operate over distributed, resource-constrained edge-cloud infrastructures. This paper proposes a structured approach for decentralizing process mining by enabling event data to be mined directly within the IoT system’s edge-cloud continuum.

pmc-10716373.creator: Yuhei Iga, Tomoko Hasegawa, Hanako Ohashi Ikeda, Yoshimichi Hirota, Manabu Miyata, Shogo Numa, Yuki Otsuka, Akitaka Tsujikawa
pmc-10716373.description: In retinitis pigmentosa (RP), photoreceptor degeneration leads to progressive visual field loss and visual impairment. Several therapeutic trials are ongoing aiming to establish effective treatments. Although functional evaluations are commonly used in clinical trials, residual ellipsoid zone (EZ) measurement on optical coherence tomography has been shown to be more sensitive to detect disease progression.

pmc-11297754.title: Diversity of ecotypes of five species of ryegrass from Northwestern Spain by phenotypic traits and microsatellites
pmc-11297754.creator: Cristina Isabel Fernández-Otero, Ana María Ramos-Cabrer, Santiago Pereira-Lorenzo
pmc-11297754.description: BackgroundThe Agricultural Research Centre of Mabegondo (Xunta de Galicia, A Coruña, Spain) conserves one of the most important collections of phytogenetic resources of ecotypes and natural populations of grassland species from northwestern Spain, among them populations of ryegrass (Lolium spp.), one of the most cultivated forage grasses in the world.

pmc-11334189.title: Ferrier Glycosylation Mediated by the TEMPO Oxoammonium Cation
pmc-11334189.creator: Luis F. Porras-Santos, Jacinto Sandoval-Lira, Julio M. Hernández-Pérez, Leticia Quintero, Pedro López-Mendoza, Fernando Sartillo-Piscil
pmc-11334189.description: The TEMPO oxoammonium cation has been proven to be both an efficient oxidizing reagent and an electrophilic substrate frequently found in organic reactions. Here, we report that this versatile chemical reagent can also be used as an efficient promoter for C- and N-glycosylation reactions through a Ferrier rearrangement with moderate to high yields.

pmc-11480415.title: Naturally acquired adaptive immunity to Streptococcus pneumoniae is impaired in rheumatoid arthritis patients
pmc-11480415.creator: Giuseppe Ercoli, Hugh Selway‐Clarke, Dena Truijen, Milda Folkmanaite, Tate Oulton, Caitlin Norris‐Grey, Rie Nakajima, Philip Felgner, Brendan W Wren, Kevin Tetteh, Nicholas J Croucher, Maria Leandro, Geraldine Cambridge, Jeremy S Brown
pmc-11480415.description: ObjectivesPatients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) have an increased susceptibility to infections, including those caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae. Why RA is associated with increased susceptibility to S. pneumoniae is poorly understood. This study aims to assess the effects of RA and B‐cell depletion therapy on naturally acquired antibody responses to 289 S. pneumoniae protein antigens using a novel protein array.

pmc-11487069.title: Tissue niche influences immune and metabolic profiles to Staphylococcus aureus biofilm infection
pmc-11487069.creator: Zachary Van Roy, Prabakar Arumugam, Blake P. Bertrand, Dhananjay D. Shinde, Vinai C. Thomas, Tammy Kielian
pmc-11487069.description: Infection is a devastating post-surgical complication, often requiring additional procedures and prolonged antibiotic therapy. This is especially relevant for craniotomy and prosthetic joint infections (PJI), both of which are characterized by biofilm formation on the bone or implant surface, respectively, with S. aureus representing a primary cause.

pmc-11519807.creator: Shan Yang, Yang Li, Mingyuan Tian, Wuquan Deng, Dongfang Liu, Chen Chen, Zhiming Zhu, Hongting Zheng, Gangyi Yang, Ling Li, Mengliu Yang

pmc-11664583.title: Continuous-Flow and Scalable Synthesis of Pd@PtnL Core–Shell Nanocrystals with Enhanced Activity toward Oxygen Reduction
pmc-11664583.creator: Helan Wang, Jianlong He, Ming Zhou, Younan Xia
pmc-11664583.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). We report a scalable method based on continuous-flow reactors for conformally coating the surfaces of facet-controlled Pd nanocrystals with uniform, ultrathin shells made of Pt. The key to the success of such an approach is the identification of a proper polyol to generate the Pt atoms at a relatively slow rate to ensure adequate surface diffusion and thus the formation of uniform shells in a layer-by-layer fashion.

pmc-12415335.title: A Mesoporous Silica-Based Naringenin Delivery System Promoting Macrophage M2 Polarization in Atherosclerosis
pmc-12415335.creator: Shenhui Ren, Junchao Liu, Hongji Pu, Penghui Wang, Xiaodong Wu, Jinbao Qin, Xiaobing Liu, Minyi Yin, Xinwu Lu, Bo Li, Zhen Zhao
pmc-12415335.description: Atherosclerosis is the leading cause of global cardiovascular morbidity and mortality associated with inflammatory and immunological mechanisms. Immunotherapy has demonstrated promising efficacy in the management of atherosclerosis. Nevertheless, certain immunotherapeutic approaches are associated with limitations, including suboptimal efficacy and non-negligible adverse effects.

pmc-12521340.title: A note on spontaneous symmetry breaking in the mean-field Bose gas
pmc-12521340.creator: Andreas Deuchert, Phan Thành Nam, Marcin Napiórkowski
pmc-12521340.description: We consider the homogeneous Bose gas in the three-dimensional unit torus, where N particles interact via a two-body potential of the form N-1v(x). The system is studied at inverse temperatures of order N-2/3, which corresponds to the temperature scale of the Bose–Einstein condensation phase transition.

pmc-12558357.title: tNGS Reveals Predominant Mixed Viral Infections in a Multicenter Retrospective Study
pmc-12558357.creator: Xiaoqi Zhang, Rui Tang, Xiaoyan Li, Lijuan Li
pmc-12558357.description: PurposeViral respiratory infections can damage epithelial cells and suppress host immunity, thereby predisposing patients to secondary bacterial or fungal infections. Accurate and timely identification of co-pathogens remains a clinical challenge. We aimed to examine whether tNGS can more comprehensively identify viral and mixed infections in comparison to conventional methods.

pmc-12638989.title: Gaussian dual adjacency graph based spatial correlated and temporal time dependent traffic prediction in Bangalore City
pmc-12638989.creator: Sathish Kumar Ravichandran, Chin-Shiuh Shieh, Mong-Fong Horng, Arulmurugan Ramu, Archana Sasi
pmc-12638989.description: With the rapid increase in the population, transportation systems are challenged by several issues. Traffic congestion is customary and traffic accidents occur frequently deteriorating traffic environments. To take the edge off these issues and enhance transportation efficiency, accurate traffic forecasting is critical.

pmc-12698176.title: Anticoagulation Treatment in Patients with Septic Thrombophlebitis of the Internal Jugular Vein
pmc-12698176.creator: Atsushi Senda, Kiyohide Fushimi, Koji Morishita
pmc-12698176.description: IntroductionSeptic thrombophlebitis of the internal jugular vein (STIJV), or Lemierre syndrome, is a rare, life-threatening condition. Anticoagulant use for managing STIJV remains unclear due to ambiguous diagnostic criteria and a lack of robust evidence. We evaluated the clinical benefits and risks of anticoagulants in patients with STIJV.

pmc-13079857.title: Adding a weight to constrain the trunk increases knee joint kinetics during sidestep cutting in female athletes
pmc-13079857.creator: Daniel Kadlec, Matthew J. Jordan, Jacqueline Alderson, Sophia Nimphius
pmc-13079857.description: Sidestep cutting exposes the knee to high multiplanar loads that both challenge tissue capacity and provide an opportunity to develop resilience through progressive exposure. This study investigated task constraints applied at the trunk and preparatory step and changes in lower-body joint kinetics associated with ACL injury risk during sidestepping in female athletes.

pmc-13110464.title: Alterations in gut microbiota and fecal metabolites in euthyroid autoimmune thyroiditis during early pregnancy
pmc-13110464.creator: Kan Chen, Zhenyu Lin, Yiyang Gao, Zhaoying Chen, Chenxi Zhang, Zhongyan Shan, Weiping Teng, Jing Li
pmc-13110464.description: Background and ObjectivesEuthyroid autoimmune thyroiditis (AIT) during early pregnancy has been linked to adverse pregnancy outcomes, yet the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. This study aimed to investigate the differences in gut microbiota (GM) composition and fecal metabolites between patients with euthyroid AIT and healthy women in the first trimester of pregnancy, and to explore potential associations between them.

An incident management team (IMT) was established, convening the public health agencies of the five nations and Food Standards Agency.

pmc-13474627.title: Coronary Microvascular Dysfunction in Ischemia With Nonobstructive Coronary Arteries and Associations With Sublingual Microvascular Abnormalities
pmc-13474627.creator: Nathaniel R Smilowitz, Abel Salas, Amanda Joa, Lillian Na, Manuela Plazas Montana, Claudia Serrano-Gomez, Ayman Farid, Anaïs Hausvater, Jeffrey S Berger, Harmony R Reynolds

It is unknown whether CMD reflects a systemic microcirculatory disorder. Sidestream darkfield (SDF) microscopy permits noninvasive imaging of red blood cells (RBCs) in the sublingual microcirculation.
